links.title: The Definitive KVM (Kernel-based Virtual Machine) API Documentation — The Linux Kernel  documentation
links.excerpt:
1. General description ¶ The kvm API is centered around different kinds of file descriptors
and ioctls that can be issued to these file descriptors.  An initial
open(“/dev/kvm”) obtains a handle to the kvm subsystem; this handle
can be used to issue system ioctls.  A KVM_CREATE_VM ioctl on this
hand
